rules: Use multi-stage builds — install deps in builder, copy /install into runner
Set PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 and PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 in base stage
Use pip install --no-cache-dir to keep image size down
Copy requirements.txt before source code to leverage layer cache
Use EXPOSE to document the listening port
securityRequirements: No .env or credentials files copied into the image
Use python:X.Y-slim (not latest or full) to minimise attack surface
USER instruction must appear before CMD/ENTRYPOINT
